comment:
* A class for a DNS SVCB response packet.
 *
 * @hide

methods.name: public boolean isResponse()
methods.comment: * Returns true if the DnsSvcbPacket is a DNS response.

methods.name: public boolean isSupported(@NonNull String alpn)
methods.comment: * Returns whether the given protocol alpn is supported.

methods.name: public String getTargetName(@NonNull String alpn)
methods.comment:
* Returns the TargetName associated with the given protocol alpn.
     * If the alpn is not supported, a null is returned.

methods.name: public int getPort(@NonNull String alpn)
methods.comment:
* Returns the TargetName that associated with the given protocol alpn.
     * If the alpn is not supported, -1 is returned.

methods.name: public List<InetAddress> getAddresses(@NonNull String alpn)
methods.comment:
* Returns the IP addresses that support the given protocol alpn.
     * If the alpn is not supported, an empty list is returned.

methods.name: public String getDohPath(@NonNull String alpn)
methods.comment:
* Returns the value of SVCB key dohpath that associated with the given protocol alpn.
     * If the alpn is not supported, a null is returned.

methods.name: private DnsSvcbRecord findSvcbRecord(@NonNull String alpn)
methods.comment:
* Returns the DnsSvcbRecord associated with the given protocol alpn.
     * If the alpn is not supported, a null is returned.

methods.name: private List<InetAddress> getAddressesFromAdditionalSection()
methods.comment: * Returns the IP addresses in additional section.

methods.name: public static DnsSvcbPacket fromResponse(@NonNull byte[] data) throws DnsPacket.ParseException
methods.comment: * Creates a DnsSvcbPacket object from the given wire-format DNS answer.

methodNames: public static DnsSvcbPacket fromResponse(@NonNull byte[] data) throws DnsPacket.ParseException
